company.name: Traveln.ai
company.shortDescription: AI-powered trip planning and booking engine helping travel businesses create personalized, bookable itineraries at scale.
company.description:
Traveln.ai is an AI-powered trip planning and booking engine designed to help travel businesses—such as airlines, OTAs, DMOs, and tour operators—generate personalized, bookable itineraries at scale.

Our platform uses a proprietary agentic architecture to automate the entire journey creation process, from destination discovery to full trip booking (flights, hotels, activities, transport, insurance, eSIM, and more). Businesses can integrate our engine via APIs or white-label widgets, offering travelers seamless, curated travel experiences tailored to their preferences.

After 3 years of R&D, Traveln.ai launched in 2024 and has since shifted from B2C to B2B, now powering integrations with regional leaders from airlines, to OTAs and SuperApps, to regional tourism authorities. We’ve also built a unified AI travel companion that works across WhatsApp, web, and mobile to support multi-channel engagement.

Traveln.ai operates as both a technology provider and booking infrastructure layer, offering revenue-sharing or usage-based pricing models. The platform supports multilingual and regional customizations, and is deployable in compliance with national cybersecurity and data localization laws (e.g., NCA in Saudi Arabia).

We are currently raising a pre-seed round to accelerate our expansion into the GCC, Europe, and Africa.
